The ai-tech category dominated intake at 117 articles, followed by news at 175 articles and wellness at 70 articles. Local content represented 46 articles while science, climate, and homelab categories each contributed between 53–60 articles. Remaining categories (design, scifi, outdoors, and homestead) accounted for 74 articles combined.

Pipeline efficiency remained stable with a mean noise-to-signal ratio of 1.6 across the 17-run historical window, indicating consistent filtering performance.
